summary: Build digital service design, governance, and KPI skills for public-sector reform. Book advanced e-government training with TrainingCred.
lede: E-government and digital public services use digital channels and shared data to design, deliver, and govern public services. For public-sector professionals responsible for service redesign or digital delivery, this training provides practical ways to map service journeys, simplify workflows, and define performance measures. Participants also practice setting governance controls and prioritizing a phased roadmap for accessible, coordinated services.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public sector professionals who need to redesign services, govern digital delivery, and report measurable service outcomes across complex public environments.
audience: Digital Product Owners for government portals
prerequisites: You should have working experience in public service delivery, digital transformation, policy implementation, service operations, or government IT governance. Prior exposure to process mapping, basic performance reporting, or citizen-facing service channels will help you get more from the exercises, but no programming is required. The course assumes you can review service data, interpret operational dashboards, and contribute to service improvement planning. Participants should bring a laptop for workshop exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted triage, automation, and digital service governance are taught at the operational application level, not at a software engineering level.
